title: Check who the data represents
summary: A dataset is a collection of examples. If some groups or situations are missing, a model may work unevenly. Check results for the people and conditions it will serve.
introduction: A dataset is a collection of examples. If some groups or situations are missing, a model may work unevenly. Check results for the people and conditions it will serve. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain check who the data represents
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A dataset is a collection of examples. If some groups or situations are missing, a model may work unevenly. Check results for the people and conditions it will serve.

blocks.code:
Sample: only clear photos in bright daylight
Planned use: photos in daylight and dim rooms
Missing check: results on suitable dim-room examples
blocks.title: Check who the data represents

blocks.text: The planned use is wider than the sample. A daylight score alone does not show whether the system works in dim rooms.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name another condition a photo dataset might miss.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume more examples automatically remove every bias in how data was collected.
